title: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU US$337.02 (~A$478.04) with PayPal Delivered @ AuroraSilicon Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU US$337.02 (~A$478.04) with PayPal Delivered @ AuroraSilicon Store AliExpress

[MrGareth] Also the 5800x3d is around $467 delivered … cheaper than the ebay sale from the other day.
Actually probably cheaper as I was using AUD pricing not US…
[UncleRico] Nice. Even cheaper with 1% via coins and 5% cashback credit from AliX.
However, the link rejects from the Top Cashback UK affiliate checker, meaning 12% capped at $50 cashback from Shopback is likely the most you can get.
Even so, by my calcs, it ends up totalling $76 in cashbacks, landing at under AU$378 if all cashbacks come thru. I think you've convinced me…
[nategasm] Shopback uses the same affiliate system, so that unaffiliated listing will not give cashback to any cashback site.
[UncleRico] How disturbing. I guess the cosmos is telling me that I really don't need to upgrade my 5700X to a 5800X3D.
I'm sure the seller, SZCPU Store, has generated cashbacks in the past. Alas…
[TH4K] Curious why the 5800x3d is high price compared to 9800? Its an old gen cpu.
[UncleRico] Plenty of people have existing AM4 boards and RAM. With current RAM and storage prices, many are looking for an upgrade to eek out a bit more performance from their systems until new PC's return to the reach of home users, rather than the exclusive domain of those evil water guzzling data centres and AI bots at SkyNet…
[averagepogenjoyer] Bought a 9800x3d from these guys before have it at -25 CO works good.
[Schrodinger] I'm seeing 9950x for around 440USD. Assuming they are real listing's.
Seems like a good deal if you need more cores.
[Clear] AuroraSilicon and SZCPU store listings are legitimate.
[Schrodinger] Thank you so much Clear!
I was also looking at the AuroraSilicon one.
Thanks to @nategasm 's user script too for flagging affiliate products.
[tastycrayon] Also the Binary Tech store.
I bought 9950x for 656 AUD(+Cashback) from SZCPU some time ago too.
If you don’t mind a simple plastic wrap it comes in, then it is a good cpu.
[flagsarefun] Thanks, picked one up. Hope the cashback tracks!
[crikey] Very tempting. Any good deals on a mid tier mobo to pair with this? Lucky for me I already have spare DDR5 ram.
[averagepogenjoyer] Running my 9800x3d + 9060xt + 32gb CL30 ram with this chinese matx mobo https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005010535200399.html
Bios is very basic, wpm fan speeds, many rgb connectors, has pcie 5.0, mATX, recent enough bios update (2026-05-04)
Haven't really had any trouble besides juhor ram can only run at cl30 6000MHz (stable) instead of cl28 6000mMHz (unstable), not sure if its ram or mobo's fault.
[Cataclysm] Hi where did you get your windows. Just bought the mobo and cpu
[averagepogenjoyer] Don't understand. Just standard procedure, make windows usb boot and activate with massgrave
[Pulseless] Tempting to sell my 7900x and go 9800x3d for gaming…
[Mrinsane] nice post Clear. this is so tempting indeed. still running R7 7700 the last deal
[UncertainRandomness] Thanks for the deal!
I've got an Asus MB. If the CPU got burned, would the RMA go through the seller on AliExpress or AMD?
[aussieprepper] Is it worth cancelling my order if it doesn't track?
[leksun] Cheers, I've taken a punt. Had a warning about "low stock" for what it's worth but it's my first AliExpress purchase so no idea how accurate that is.
[Pandafaust] Previously popular? I'm pretty sure it's still fairly popular!
I have one myself and it's… frankly more power than I need for my purposes, if I'm being honest with myself.
[12nd] Thanks! Cashback tracked as £87.56 (~A$123) pending for me shortly after purchasing.
[terroz] I bought from the JS-computer link and topcashback tracked it, its now pending. Would it go through or should I cancel and use another the first link to play safe
[averagepogenjoyer] imo cancel JS isn't affiliated so high chance it won't track
[nategasm] Unaffiliated listings can still track, but they likely won't pay out.
[J0hn] Can't recommend this enough…. got this paired with 5080
